services.name: Ghost Tours
services.desc: Spend an evening in one of the oldest restored homes in the Hernando County area… a beautiful Victorian mansion filled with the energies of a bygone era. _______________________________________________________________________________________ During the first hour a docent will take you through the house and tell you about actual evidence collected over the years. During the second hour you can revisit any area of the house and conduct your own investigation! A fun evening for a great cause.

services.name: Honor Walk Program
services.desc: Engrave a brick to honor a loved one or commemorate a special occasion. These bricks will be incorporated into a permanent “Honor Walk Memorial” at your selected museum. When filling out each line, there are a maximum of 13 characters to include spaces and special characters. The bricks are 4 X 8 inches and will be engraved and have a lifetime warranty. If you wish, you can see a sample brick on display at the gift shops located in the May-Stringer Museum, the 1885 Train Depot and the Countryman One Room Schoolhouse. blurb: The Brooksville Train Depot was built in 1885 by the Florida Southern Railroad as it moved south through central Florida. This original building, on the same site, hosts artifacts and historical stories of the growth of the railroad in the Florida and the United States.
